Thank you Nishnai team, Aniket, Praveen, Sanika, Babubhai, & Pallavi for giving us the opportunity to visit and explore Rajasthan - Jodhpur and Jaisalmer and making our tour successful.  This was my 2nd trip with Nishnai Holidays.  The tour started with travelling via Suryanagari Express on 5 March 2026.   I joined the tour as a solo traveler but met a group of friendly people.  Everyone seemed energetic and excited about tour; had been making reels, playing antakshari, dancing on Music.  At Jodhpur, we visited Mehrangarh Fort, Museum, other places, and explored local market best known for handcrafts.   The guides provided us the facts, the historical information about the places.  At Jaisalmer, we visited Sonar fort, Patwon ki Haveli and explored many antique things including utensils, gramophone, telephone, furniture, kerosene fridge, etc.  We visited Bada Bagh, and kuldhara village and learned the history behind its curse.  We enjoyed sam dunes, tent stay, camel ride, Rajasthani cultural program, music, and dinner.   The meals were good along with chaas and desserts.  All hotel rooms were clean, spacious, and royal with good water supply and geyser and AC facility.   Transport AC bus was excellent. I enjoyed the tour and Womens Day celebration with cake, games, reels, and lots of fun.
💯 Value for money.
💯 recommended
